parsed.visual_overview: A horizontal split-screen video. The top half features an AI-generated humanoid presenter speaking directly to the camera against a stage-like background. The bottom half displays a series of satisfying ASMR clips, including kinetic sand and foam cutting. Text overlays appear in the center throughout the video.

characters.name: Miss Nova
characters.brief: AI tutor avatar, humanoid robot with a human face and exposed metallic neck/head components, wearing a dark blue shirt.

scenes.scene_brief: AI presenter speaks on top while a hand presses a wire mesh into kinetic sand on the bottom.
scenes.supernova_script:
Miss Nova says: You definitely can't speak good English without actually speaking out loud.
Miss Nova says: But let's be honest, not everyone is always ready to practice with you.

scenes.scene_brief: AI presenter continues speaking on top while a loop tool carves lines into green kinetic sand on the bottom.
scenes.supernova_script:
Miss Nova says: Plus, there's that fear of making mistakes in front of others.
Miss Nova says: That is exactly why over one crore users practice with Supernova AI.
Miss Nova says: It's about seven times cheaper than offline classes.
Miss Nova says: You can speak with me as much as you want, without feeling shy.

scenes.scene_brief: AI presenter speaks on top while a knife slices open a colorful foam block on the bottom.
scenes.supernova_script:
Miss Nova says: Make a thousand mistakes, and I will never judge you or get bored.
Miss Nova says: I'll just correct you in your own language so it makes sense.
Miss Nova says: So click the install button and download Supernova AI right now.

scenes.scene_brief: AI presenter finishes speaking on top while a textured roller creates patterns on pink kinetic sand on the bottom.
scenes.supernova_script: Miss Nova says: Start speaking with me today, and see real improvement in just 21 days!
